CAT 串口命令经网络转发，配合音频流（VoIP）实现远程收发。: CAT serial commands are forwarded over the network, combined with audio streaming (VoIP) for remote transmit and receive.
RemoteRig、FlexRadio SmartSDR、开源的 OpenWeb: RemoteRig, FlexRadio SmartSDR, and open-source options such as OpenWebRX/RemoteTx.
做好安全：鉴权、加密、限权，防止未授权使用。: Take security seriously: authentication, encryption and limited privileges, to prevent unauthorised use.
远程端需稳定网络与备份电源，避免失联后电台无法关停。: The remote end needs a stable network and backup power, so the radio can still be shut down if contact is lost.
通过互联网从异地控制电台，用于在位置受限时使用高性能台站。: Controlling a radio over the Internet from elsewhere, allowing a high-performance station to be used from a restricted location.
遵守执照规定，远程台站仍由持证操作员负责。: Follow the licence rules: the remote station remains the responsibility of the licensed operator.
音频延迟与网络抖动会影响操作，优先有线/低延迟网络。: Audio latency and network jitter affect operation, so prefer wired or low-latency connections.
